messages:
maya: :rotating_light: seeing 5-10x p95 latency for hosted-generation in apac-north since 08:12 UTC. Error spike in runtime too.
cheng: I'm on it, grabbing metrics. Is this widespread or specific to certain models?
maya: mostly gptx-1 variants and long-seq traffic. p99 spikes to ~6s. Throughput dropped by 40%.
sam: logs show repeated KV cache misses and compaction churn on nodes apac-north-*. Heap GC aligning with batch timeouts.
ryan: any deploys around the time? I see a runtime canary earlier that flipped batching heuristic.
paula: yep, we rolled horovod/batcher 2.3.1 -> 2.4.0 at 07:55 in apac-north for affinity fixes.
cheng: that aligns. New batcher enabled aggressive prefetch which is thrashing KV cache for long prompts.
maya: ops-bot, can you pull hotpool capacity and inflight queue sizes?
ops-bot: hotpool: total_gpus=420, available=28, inflight=380, avg_queue_ms=1800
sam: available 28 in a 420 pool — we're effectively saturated.
ryan: suggest immediate traffic shift for gptx-1 to na1 and eu-central fallback variants.
maya: agreed. Pausing deployments in apac-north and shifting 30% of gptx-1 traffic now.
paula: running routing change:
```
rbctl route modify --model gptx-1 --from-region apac-north --to-regions na1:0.2,eu-central:0.1
```
cheng: also add model-variant fallback in runtime policy to avoid long-seq prefetch path:
```
service.runtime.policy.update --model gptx-1 --fallback gptx-1-quantized --prefetch=false
```
ops-bot: routing change applied, 30% diverted. Fallback policy applied.
maya: p95 latency dropping to ~1.6s for diverted traffic. apac-north p95 still 4.8s but trending.
sam: starting emergency hotpool scale in apac-north: adding 64 GPUs from our reserve.
paula: provisioning request sent to infra-provisioner: job 8732. ETA ~7m.
infra-bot: provisioner accepted job 8732, estimated 6m.
ryan: we should also temporarily lower batch size for long-seq traffic to reduce KV churn. Changing runtime config.
cheng: applied batch_size_max: 8 -> 4 for long_seq class.
maya: nice, p99 now 2.9s active for apac-north for long sequences. p95 2.1s.
sam: hotpool nodes coming up, 64 GPUs join pool.
ops-bot: hotpool update: total_gpus=484, available=62, inflight=320, avg_queue_ms=600
maya: system steady. continuing to monitor. Cost note: diverting 30% to na1 increases cross-region egress estimates ~ $4.2k/hr.
paula: we should open a quick RFC for rollback if the batcher regression is root cause. @cheng can you prepare a postmortem draft?
cheng: on it. Will include metrics, deploy diff, and remediation plan (rollback batcher and add canary telemetry).
ryan: also add a temporary safeguard: runtime should auto-disable prefetch when kv-miss-rate > 0.15.
maya: agreed. Who owns that change?
sam: infra-engineering can push hotfix, I'll pair with cheng.
paula: tagging as incident-bridge, filling incident ticket INC-2026.
maya: thanks everyone. Keeping bridge open for 30m for verification. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident INC-2026 created. Bridge link: https://meet.example/incident-INC-2026
cheng: postmortem draft started: will share in ~90m.
ryan: add cost impact estimate and customer-facing talking points.
paula: will coordinate comms if any customer SLAs were affected.
maya: closing update for now — monitoring only. ping if regressions recur.
